title: 第1277章 战至尊仙胎第1276章 肉山倒塌
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
“不。”
“珊儿…不想…这样……”
肉身褪去，烂泥之中，躺着一个皮肤苍白、五官绝艳的女子。
她终于记起。
当初的她也不是那么毅然决然做出了选择，只是羡慕兄长的地位与权威，才抛弃一切。
现在，她有些后悔了。
“可如果能重来……”她的嘴角泛起一丝苦涩的笑容，“我还是会做出同样的选择吧。”
烂泥中的肉虫将她最后的尸首吞噬。
覆山姥姥终是迎来了落幕。
至此，所有苏醒的腐朽大修皆至终局，或抛弃修士之身，泯灭人格于混沌神魔体内。
或自我兵解，被李元击杀。
此刻，魔渊一片寂静。
魔道小儿不敢啼哭，在诸多魔修眼中，李元就是一个杀神，今朝归来注定要杀出一条血路。
轰隆隆！
也就在这时，魔渊震动。
嘭！嘭！嘭！
魔渊之中多处炸开，形成一个个阵点，在天地之力下快速连接，最终化作一个天地大阵。
远远观望，此阵便如胎儿的形状。
紧接着，魔渊大阵的纹路上，显化出密密麻麻的金色符文，形成了一篇仙道经文。
仙经上的每一个文字都散发着令人心悸的气息，仿佛自亘古之前便已刻在这里。

只是此刻，力量注入，它们才被激活。
显然是一场针对李元，早已布置好的阴谋。
“李元，本尊等你很久了。”
雄浑的声音炸响，一道身影沐浴着神光而至。
李元抬首，望向天穹，只见那道身影踏着无数异象，被天地大道拥簇，走来时犹如一幅史诗画卷徐徐展开。
至尊仙胎…又变强了！
这就是天地间的第一修行体质，时时刻刻都在变强，过去的几千年里就像奔腾的江流，从来没有停歇。
在李元计划复仇时，至尊仙胎也在想。
这是两人的宿命之战。
过去因为种种阻隔，两人始终未能真正战上一场，但积累的血仇是不可能化解的。
神工杀了至尊仙胎一世身的姐姐‘兰’。
李元杀了至尊仙胎一世身的哥哥‘尘’。
至尊仙胎又杀了于李元而言如师如友的神工。
恩恩怨怨，双方必有一死才可终结。
轰隆隆！
魔渊之外，沉娘子坐不住了，想要破阵而入，却是被一道浑身沐浴在黑色气息中的大魔阻拦。
当今世道，魔道第一人早已不是罗衣尊者，也不是第一大魔，那都是过去的魔道辉煌了。
如今的魔道第一人是白眉的恶尸，黑暗洛净生。
吞噬了自愿献上生灵愿力的晏巡天之后，黑暗洛净生已然达到了至高层次，足以和沉娘子抗衡。
唰——！

下一刻，孟姜也现身了，死死盯着黑暗洛净生。
然而，黑暗洛净生旁边同样出现了一道身影，是天庭的魂天主。
明眼人都知晓，李元此番归来，必定要开启清算之路，有些人注定是逃不过的。
至尊仙胎牧野，天庭魂天主，缥缈仙殿白眉首当其冲。
所以，他们默契的结成了‘同盟’。
content_en:
"No."
"Shan'er...don't want...this..."
The fleshy body faded away, and lying in the mud was a woman with pale skin and stunning facial features.
She finally remembered.
She didn't make the choice so resolutely at the beginning. She was just envious of her brother's status and authority, so she gave up everything.
Now, she regrets it a little.
"But if I could do it over again..." A bitter smile appeared on the corner of her mouth, "I would still make the same choice."
Flesh worms in the mud devoured her last corpse.
Grandma Fushan has finally come to an end.
At this point, all the awakened corrupt cultivators have come to an end, or have abandoned their monk bodies and lost their personality in the body of chaotic gods and demons.
Or he surrendered himself and was killed by Li Yuan.
At this moment, there was silence in the Demonic Abyss.
The demon child dared not cry. In the eyes of many demon cultivators, Li Yuan was a god of murder, and he was destined to blaze a trail of blood when he returned.
Boom!
At this moment, the Demonic Abyss shook.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Many places exploded in the Demonic Abyss, forming formation points, which were quickly connected by the power of heaven and earth, and finally turned into a great formation of heaven and earth.
Looking from a distance, this formation looks like the shape of a fetus.
Immediately afterwards, dense golden runes appeared on the lines of the Demonic Abyss Formation, forming an immortal scripture.
Every word in the Immortal Scripture exudes a heart-stopping aura, as if it had been engraved here since eternity.
It was only at this moment that power was injected that they were activated.
It was obviously a conspiracy that had been laid out against Li Yuan.
"Li Yuan, I have been waiting for you for a long time."
A majestic voice exploded, and a figure came bathed in divine light.
Li Yuan raised his head and looked at the sky, only to see that figure walking on countless visions, surrounded by the avenues of heaven and earth, and it was like an epic scroll slowly unfolding as it walked.
The Supreme Immortal Fetus...has become stronger again!
This is the number one cultivation physique in the world. It is getting stronger all the time. In the past few thousand years, it has been like a rushing river that never stops.
When Li Yuan planned revenge, the Supreme Immortal Fetus was also thinking about it.
This is a fateful battle between two people.
Due to various obstacles in the past, the two have never been able to truly fight, but the accumulated blood feud cannot be resolved.
Shen Gong killed the elder sister ‘Lan’ who was born in the Supreme Immortal Pregnancy.
Li Yuan killed the supreme immortal’s brother ‘Chen’.
The Supreme Immortal Fetus once again killed the divine craftsman who was like a teacher and a friend to Li Yuan.
Gratitude and resentment can only end if both parties die.
Boom!
Outside the Demonic Abyss, Mrs. Shen couldn't sit still and wanted to break through the formation, but was blocked by a great demon bathed in black aura.
In today's world, the number one person in the devil's path is no longer Venerable Luo Yi, nor is he the greatest demon. Those are all the glory of the devil's path in the past.
The number one person in the demonic path today is Baimei’s evil corpse, Dark Luo Jingsheng.
After devouring Yan Xantian, who voluntarily offered his life force, Dark Luo Jingsheng has reached the highest level, enough to compete with Mrs. Shen.
Swish——!
The next moment, Meng Jiang also appeared, staring at the dark Luo Jingsheng.
However, a figure also appeared next to Luo Jingsheng in the dark, it was the Soul God of Heaven.
Anyone with a discerning eye knows that when Li Yuan returns this time, he will definitely start a path of reckoning, and some people are destined to be unable to escape.
The Supreme Immortal Fetus Makino, the Heavenly Soul God, and the Piaomiao Immortal Palace Baimei are the first to bear the brunt.
Therefore, they formed an 'alliance' tacitly.
